thread:
anya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we keep seeing a recurring incident motif - KV eviction spikes -> routing fallback -> tokenization edge failures downstream. We need concrete owners for remediation work and tests to prevent recurrence (regression entries, curated prompt sets, mixed load tests, and a short chaos drill).

dmitri: I'll take the detection/dashboard work. Plan: add an anomaly detector for sudden KV eviction rate + fallback count and a weekly digest. ETA: 48hrs for a working dashboard, 1 week for alerts.

rachel: I'll own the regression and prompt curation. Approach: extract 40 representative failing prompts, tag severity, add unit-level assertions to the eval harness, and wire high-severity prompts as gating checks. CSV format: id,input,expected_snippet,severity,notes. I can upload by Fri.

omar: I'll run a mixed load test that combines steady inference traffic with periodic KV churn to reproduce memory-pressure + fallback patterns. Need CAP for a sandbox cluster configured with low cache memory to trigger evictions. If CAP approved, I can run Tue morning.

eng-sre-bot: CAP templates available: https://confluence.redwood.ai/infra/cap-templates Recommend tagging "chaos-sandbox".

dmitri: For alerting, what SLOs do we want tied to the digest? Suggest p95 latency < 350ms, fallback rate < 0.5%, error rate < 0.1% over 5m windows.

anya: Those SLOs sound good. Also want a metric for "regression reopens" (how often post-deploy regressions from incident prompts recur). Add that to the dashboard, dmitri.

rachel: I'll mark high-severity cases as gating in the harness so canary fails fast. Will also add a shorter nightly job that runs just the incident set (fast smoke).

omar: CAP-2233 created: https://tracker.redwood.ai/CAP-2233 requesting 3 sandbox nodes with eviction tuning. Scheduling tentative drill Tue 09:30 PT.

eng-sre-bot: Reminder: include rollback criteria and a stairstep ramp for traffic in the drill playbook.

dmitri: Dashboard ticket opened: https://github.com/redwood/observability/issues/212 includes weekly digest and regression-reopen metric.

rachel: Uploaded prompt set: evals/incident-sets/INC-2055.csv and filed evals issue https://github.com/redwood/evals/issues/114. CSV includes severity and expected_snippet fields.

anya: Timelines recap: dmitri dashboard 48hrs, rachel CSV Fri EOD + harness PR early next week, omar CAP created and drill Tue 09:30 PT. I'll add these to remediation board REM-3421 and create a recurring monthly "incident-pattern review".

omar: Running the mixed load test will post logs to CAP-2233. Tagging eng-sre for real-time monitoring during the drill.

dmitri: I'll add an automated ticket flow: alert -> triage -> eval add -> remediation board card. Hoping this reduces manual follow-ups.

eng-sre-bot: Note: mark high-severity prompts as gating checks in PRs and ensure deployment window has an ops observer.

anya: Great. Owners locked. Please paste GH/ticket links into the REM-3421 card when ready. We'll do a short post-drill validation sync Wed and close action items if green. Thanks! :thumbsup:
